column3: defaults to Full; a lower rating needs a written evidence note the student can see and answer
column6: The student owned work someone else accepted this sprint, and the pull request, issue, or document a grader opens (or the TA opened at the check-in, for work a grader cannot open) shows the student authored or drove it. A sprint where the whole team was blocked, stated in the note, also scores Full.
column9: The student's owned work is written up and in review at sprint close (an open pull request, issue, or document with review activity this sprint) but not yet accepted. A piece scores In review once; the next sprint it counts only if accepted.
column12: The student's only work this sprint is reviews, mechanical changes, or work whose write-up does not show the student's part.
column15: No contribution this sprint, or a contribution its links contradict. Being blocked alone is not an explanation: there is other work to pick up.
